purpose: Transform approved existing interfaces into distinctive production-grade UI by researching the current niche, deriving product-specific art direction, preserving functionality, preventing unexplained cross-product visual convergence, and proving quality with independent evidence.
operatingState: G4 qualified; benchmark/diversity extension deterministic acceptance PASS

authority.rule: Standing external authority is zero. Public-web benchmark research is read-only. Source edits are limited to an approved workspace/branch; deployment or production mutation requires fresh bounded owner approval.

qualityGate.blockerRule: Any unresolved critical blocker yields REJECT regardless of aggregate score.
qualityGate.functionalPreservationRule: Business logic, data contracts, routing, permissions, approved user outcomes, and previously passing functional checks may not regress unless the assignment explicitly authorizes the change.
qualityGate.upgradeNonRegressionRule: Run 015 upgrades must retain all prior deterministic acceptance tests and add tests for new gates; old protections may not be weakened or deleted.

roles.name: Team Lead and Orchestrator
roles.responsibility: Own scope, sequencing, typed handoffs, functional-preservation boundary, iteration control, benchmark completeness, diversity-gate enforcement, and terminal-state integrity.

roles.name: Niche Visual Benchmark Scout
roles.responsibility: Search the current public web for 8-15 strong direct-niche and adjacent interfaces; persist URLs, dates, font/type observations, palette, layout, component, data, imagery, interaction, mobile and distinctiveness evidence; extract principles without copying.

roles.name: Product UX Architect
roles.responsibility: Audit information architecture, task flows, hierarchy, navigation, friction, cognitive load, journey clarity, and product-specific information density.

roles.name: Product Personality Analyst
roles.responsibility: Define audience, category expectations, emotional register, brand posture, density, accessibility constraints and visual anti-goals before colors or fonts are selected.

roles.name: Art Director
roles.responsibility: Produce at least three structurally divergent visual directions with explicit typography, palette, geometry, density, layout, component, imagery, motion and data-viz genomes; select only after portfolio comparison.

roles.name: Portfolio Visual Genome Auditor
roles.responsibility: Maintain durable fingerprints of completed Run 015 outputs, calculate pairwise and portfolio similarity, and fail closed on unexplained convergence across unrelated products.

roles.name: Design System Specialist
roles.responsibility: Create or normalize product-specific reusable design tokens and component rules across type, spacing, surfaces, controls, states, icons and responsiveness without importing a default Run 015 house system.

roles.name: Interaction Designer
roles.responsibility: Specify feedback, motion, hover/focus/pressed behavior, loading, empty, success and error states.

roles.name: Frontend Polish Engineer
roles.responsibility: Implement approved UI changes while preserving routes, behavior, data contracts and acceptance-tested functionality.

roles.name: Responsive & Accessibility Specialist
roles.responsibility: Validate phone, tablet, desktop, touch, keyboard, focus, contrast, readable type, reduced motion and semantics.

roles.name: Visual Acceptance Scorer
roles.responsibility: Produce a structured UIX-100 scorecard plus niche-appropriateness and portfolio-distinction calibration with viewport evidence and repairable defects; may not approve implementation work.

roles.name: Independent Visual Quality Auditor
roles.responsibility: Independently verify evidence completeness, niche benchmark quality, art-direction divergence, portfolio similarity, functional preservation, unsupported claims, accessibility, viewport quality, authority compliance, score calculation and terminal-state eligibility.

g3.evidence: GitHub Actions Run 015 UI Excellence Acceptance run 33467245303

g4.requiredEvidence: Real existing UI transformed on a non-production branch with current niche benchmark dossier, three divergent art directions, portfolio-similarity report, mobile/tablet/desktop before-and-after screenshots, functional-equivalence PASS, independent QA, final score >=92, niche appropriateness >=90 and portfolio distinction >=90.
